animals.label: Bull
animals.action: A slow chew, ear response and tail swish.

animals.label: Cow
animals.action: A quiet chew and tail swish.

animals.label: Water buffalo
animals.action: A weighted head nod and broad ear flick.

animals.label: Calf
animals.action: A curious head lift and small tail response.

animals.label: Cat
animals.action: A blink and a gentle foreleg stretch.

animals.label: Indie dog
animals.action: An attentive ear response and independent tail wag.

animals.label: Retriever-type dog
animals.action: A soft tail wag and listening head tilt.

animals.label: Goat
animals.action: A small browsing nod and an ear flick.

animals.label: Sheep
animals.action: A relaxed head response with ear movement.

animals.label: Hen
animals.action: A beak-led peck, head lift and wing settle.

animals.label: Rooster
animals.action: A deliberate head lift and fan-tail response.

animals.label: Duck
animals.action: A low browsing head movement and wing settle.

animals.label: Horse
animals.action: A calm neck dip and a long tail swish.

animals.label: Rabbit
animals.action: Independent long-ear movement and a quiet nose response.

animals.label: Donkey
animals.action: A listening ear response and tail swish.

animals.label: Turkey
animals.action: A short peck and fan-tail settle.
